# meshmsg v0.1.22

This release fixes reliable peer rediscovery after a daemon restart and supersedes v0.1.21 for reliable restart discovery.

## Presence reliability

- Fixes restart rediscovery with one bounded signed presence reannouncement when the first derived-presence neighbor connection is established.
- Consumes the daemon-lifetime first-neighbor trigger before attempting the bounded announcement, avoiding reconnect announcement storms and preventing failures or later churn from creating retries.
- Retains the 30-second periodic presence refresh as the later convergence fallback.

## Compatibility and limits

- Leaves protocol v3 unchanged, including the 65,536-byte signed-envelope maximum and 65,358-byte broadcast-body maximum.
- Leaves private/direct-message limits unchanged at a 4,096-byte body and 6 KiB frame.
- Introduces no protocol or persistent-state format changes from v0.1.21.

Install this exact source release after the tag is published:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg \
  --tag v0.1.22 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.21...v0.1.22
